payload.body: You tend to tolerate a demand, interruption, or crossed boundary until one more incident produces a sharp reply or an abrupt refusal. The current problem is usually real, but the force of the reaction also belongs to earlier times when saying no did not feel available. Anger becomes harder to aim when several situations are being answered at once. Address the first problem before responding to several old ones at the same time.
